plainTranslation: Their familiar patterns work easily with how you present yourself and enter situations, so the interaction can feel recognizable without much adjustment.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their familiar patterns work easily with how you present yourself and enter situations, so the interaction can feel recognizable without much adjustment. You may move quickly into a known way of acting around them, and the ease can support trust or simply preserve a habit. Familiarity can be useful, but it is not proof of fate and does not show whether the pattern should continue.
